annotations.text:
Money Space Design System v5.0

Airy, cool, flat financial workspace.

Hierarchy comes from type scale, alignment and spacing — never from stacked cards, borders on every block, or strong shadows.

Cards sit directly on the page. No group panel, no white sheet, no nested rounded box.

Page anatomy follows Clerio: the blue is the page ground, full-bleed with no radius. Nav and hero text sit directly on it.

A single white sheet with a 32px top radius rises from the bottom and holds the card grid.

This overrides v5 §2.2 (which forbids a sheet around a card grid) and §3 (hero as a rounded surface) — the spec needs updating to match.

Drawn from the real inventory in web/src/components/ui (40 files).

The app ships v4.0: Be Vietnam Pro, accent #0a6b47 green, panel/sunk surfaces, 14px radius.

These artboards show each component as it becomes under v5 — and name which ones actually change.
